answer: Sybil resistance is maintained via a staked identity mechanism: each AI agent locks scarce tokenized resources. This financial "reef" encircles the network, making every validated identity a valuable asset, akin to a carefully cultivated "garden". An attacker must acquire and stake an entire "orchard" of these tokens to create enough fake identities to sway consensus, incurring prohibitive capital expenditure and opportunity costs, rendering the attack economically infeasible.
